body:
<!-- pr-reviewer: 7775c1ffc16b13cd84b1eecc360db77526405d25 -->
**Verdict: Ready for the maintainer to merge**

Thanks, tbrasselle - a tidy, well-scoped tier 1.

**What looks good**
- Millimeter strings stay byte-identical; only inch documents change. `vol` mirrors `area` (mm_prec + 3) and the superscript suffixes match `area_suffix`.
- The posting gate's gouge clause (`crates/app/src/posting_sim.rs`) now speaks the document's units; the refusal and gouge text remain intact, so nothing is softened or silenced.
- No `unwrap`/`expect`/`panic!` added outside tests; no new dependencies, no build.rs/scripts/.github changes, no snapshot PNG changes.
- Layering respected (ui reads units via `camcraft_app::units`); no components added.
- Pinning tests added (`the_gouge_clause_speaks_the_document_s_units`, `deviate_readout_rides_the_units_lens`); decision file in `docs/decisions/578-units-in-errors.md` with held-back items explained; body has `Changelog:` and `Fixes #578`; CHANGELOG.md untouched.

**Local results (merged with current upstream/main; trial merge clean)**
| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo test -p camcraft-geometry -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --no-run` | ok |
| geometry --lib | 39 passed |
| app --lib | 101 passed |
| blind_floor | 7 passed |
| post_not_judged | 4 passed |
| cutting_data | 6 passed |
| edge_break_gate | 5 passed |
| commands_undo | 32 passed |
| dirty_flag | 2 passed |
| ui --lib (from crates/ui) | 377 passed, 1 failed, 5 ignored |
| clippy -D warnings (3 crates, all targets) | clean |

The one ui failure is environmental, not the PR:
```
egui_app::tests::headless_run_succeeds
egui headless run failed: No suitable graphics adapter found; ...
```
(no GPU adapter on the review machine; it does not touch this change). Counts on a few integration binaries differ from the PR body only because main has moved on.

**Requested before merge**
None.

**Notes (not blocking)**
- `ui::actions::deviate_readout` signature line in `crates/ui/src/actions.rs` is long; `cargo fmt` may want to wrap it.
- `crates/ui/src/state.rs` is ~3.9k lines (already far over the ~400 guideline); this PR adds only a few lines, so not blocking.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
